title: Clans
summary: The lineage networks that connect families across communities.
body: Clans form the backbone of Murle social organization, linking families across different villages through shared ancestry. Clan membership shapes obligations of hospitality, cooperation, and support during major life events.

Marriage customs are closely tied to clan identity, with certain marriage patterns encouraged or avoided depending on clan relationships. This helps maintain broad social ties across the wider community.
Clan elders often play a quiet but important role in mediating disputes and preserving genealogical knowledge passed down through oral history.
